products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) RS-2 Funnel Shaker is designed for efficient mixing of samples in separatory funnels, combining double-sided vertical reciprocation with an adjustable tilt of up to 20 degrees for enhanced mixing efficiency.
features: Vertical and Tilted Reciprocation: Vertical reciprocation up to 300 rpm with a 40 mm stroke, plus an adjustable shake tilt from 0 to 20 degrees, achieves high mixing efficiency even at low rpm.
Durable BLDC Motor: A BLDC motor provides outstanding durability, a lower noise level and enhanced stability compared with competitor products that use DC motors.
One-Touch Funnel Handling: A one-touch mechanism allows swift, easy funnel installation and removal, so samples can be loaded and unloaded quickly and comfortably.
Stable, Low-Vibration Design: A stable centre-of-gravity design minimises vibration even with one-sided sample installation or high-speed tilted movement.
High Funnel Capacity: The RS-2 fits cone or cylindrical funnels up to 2 L, and can hold up to ten <0.5 L funnels, six 0.5-1 L funnels or four 2 L funnels, with up to five holders per side.
Tilted Controller: A controller with the display panel set at a 20-degree angle gives good visibility even from floor level, with an error alarm and status indicator for easy operation.
Safety Features: Safety devices protect the user and the experiment, including overcurrent protection and automatic resumption of operation when power returns after a failure.
Flexible Scheduling: A count-down timer up to 999 hr 59 min and an optional LC Connected mobile monitoring network give flexibility in experiment planning.

faqs.question: What is the RS-2 Funnel Shaker used for?
faqs.answer: It is used to mix samples in separatory funnels, mainly for liquid-liquid extraction and sample preparation.

faqs.question: What motion does it use?
faqs.answer: Double-sided vertical reciprocation combined with an adjustable tilt from 0 to 20 degrees.

faqs.question: What is the speed range?
faqs.answer: 30 to 300 rpm in vertical motion and 30 to 250 rpm in inclined motion, with a 40 mm stroke.

faqs.question: How many funnels can it hold?
faqs.answer: Up to four 2 L funnels, six 0.5-1 L funnels, or ten funnels under 0.5 L, with up to five holders per side.

faqs.question: What funnels are compatible?
faqs.answer: Cone or cylindrical separatory funnels up to 2 L. Funnels are not supplied.

faqs.question: What motor does it use?
faqs.answer: A BLDC motor, which offers better durability, lower noise and improved stability than DC-motor designs.

faqs.question: What is the maximum load?
faqs.answer: Up to 5 kg per side; the load should be balanced across both sides.

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: Overcurrent protection and automatic resumption of operation after a power failure, plus an error alarm and status indicator.

faqs.question: Can it be monitored remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, optionally via the LC Connected mobile network using LC GreenBox.

faqs.question: How much space does it need?
faqs.answer: 600 x 460 x 470 mm, or 900 x 460 x 670 mm allowing for the 20-degree tilt.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help with setup and training?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help with holder selection, loading, installation and user training.

A BLDC motor provides outstanding durability, lower noise and improved stability compared with DC-motor designs, and a stable centre-of-gravity construction minimises vibration even with one-sided loading or high-speed tilted movement.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) OS Series Dual Action Shakers are benchtop platform shakers that combine orbital and reciprocating motion for flexible, efficient mixing of flasks, funnels, tubes and microplates.
features: Dual-Action Motion: Orbital and reciprocating shaking motions in a single platform shaker give flexibility for a wide range of mixing and culturing applications.
High Speed with PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with shaking-speed calibration delivers a competitive high speed up to 500 rpm, with a wide speed range even under heavy workloads.
Maintenance-Free BLDC Motor: A maintenance-free BLDC motor generates smooth, quiet, uniform and powerful shaking, with smooth acceleration and deceleration control for a pleasant test environment.
Best-Effort Run Function: A best-effort run function intelligently manages rpm to keep the platform shaking even when the workload exceeds its rated capacity.
Low-Vibration Design: A low-profile design minimises vibration and sliding caused by high-speed shaking, keeping the shaker stable on the bench.
Repeatable Positioning: The platform stops where it starts, so repetitive tasks are easy and the fixed stop position benefits automated dosing or sampling.

Clear VFD Display and Timer: A user-friendly control panel with Lab Companion's bright VFD display, a durable membrane touch switch and control knob, and an easy-set digital timer from 1 minute to 999 hr 59 min make operation simple.
Flexible Speed Setting: Speed is set and displayed in 1 rpm increments, and the increment interval can be changed among 1, 5 or 10 rpm to suit user preference.
Connectivity and Monitoring: RS-232 and USB ports allow external control and data collection, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox enables monitoring anytime, anywhere.
Safety Features: Safety features include automatic run after a power interruption, a shaking-speed deviation alarm, overcurrent protection and a stalled-platform check.

faqs.question: What motion does the OS Series use?
faqs.answer: Dual-action shaking with both orbital and reciprocating motion (the OS-4000 offers orbital to 500 rpm and reciprocal to 450 rpm).

faqs.question: What is the speed range?
faqs.answer: 20 to 500 rpm, with ±1 rpm or ±1% speed stability.

faqs.question: What amplitude options are available?
faqs.answer: 19.1 mm default, with 12.7 mm available on the OS-2000 and 25.4 mm available on the OS-3000 and OS-4000.

faqs.question: What is the largest flask it can hold?
faqs.answer: Up to 6 L on the OS-3000 and OS-4000 (the OS-2000 handles up to 1 L).

faqs.question: How much load can it take?
faqs.answer: Up to 16 kg on the OS-2000, 18 kg on the OS-3000 and 21 kg on the OS-4000 at 300 rpm; up to 500 rpm at lighter loads.

faqs.question: What happens if I overload it?
faqs.answer: A best-effort run function intelligently manages rpm to keep the platform shaking even beyond rated capacity.

faqs.question: Does the platform stop in a fixed position?
faqs.answer: Yes. It stops where it starts, which helps with automated dosing or sampling.

faqs.question: What motor does it use?
faqs.answer: A maintenance-free BLDC motor for smooth, quiet, uniform and powerful shaking.

faqs.question: Can it be monitored remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, via RS-232, USB, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring using LC GreenBox.

faqs.question: Do I need a platform and clamps?
faqs.answer: Yes. A universal platform is sold separately, and clamps, racks or holders are chosen for your vessels.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) OS-7000 Series General Shakers are large open-air orbital platform shakers built to handle heavy workloads with a powerful driving system and a durable body structure.
features: Powerful Direct-Drive System: An ideal DD (Direct Drive) brushless motor and triple cam system support heavy loads with high torque at high speed, quiet running, smooth rotation and maintenance-free operation.

High Speed with PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with an intelligent speed controller and shaking-speed calibration delivers reproducible results at a competitive high speed up to 500 rpm, with a wide speed range even under heavy workloads.

Best-Effort Run and Auto Adjustment: A best-effort run function keeps the platform shaking even beyond rated capacity, and automatic speed adjustment responds to unbalanced load placement, unusual vibration or external shock.

Smooth Start and Stop: Smooth acceleration and deceleration control, with smooth start and smooth stop functions, prevents chemical spills from flasks or test tubes and provides a pleasant test environment.
Low-Vibration Design: A low-profile design minimises vibration and sliding caused by high-speed shaking, keeping the large platform stable during operation.

Flexible Speed Setting: Speed is set and displayed in 1 rpm increments, and the increment interval can be changed among 1, 5 or 10 rpm to suit user preference.

Connectivity and Accessories: Built-in RS-232 and USB ports allow external control and data collection, a variety of accessories meet different application demands, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox enables monitoring anytime, anywhere.
Safety Features: Safety features include automatic run after a power interruption, a shaking-speed deviation alarm and overcurrent protection.

products.subhead: Combined heating and high-speed orbital mixing with programmable interval-mix control
products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) CBS-350 Heating Shaker combines precise temperature control with high-speed orbital mixing, and its interval-mix function in program mode can be set to match each user's experimental conditions.
features: Combined Heating and Mixing: The CBS-350 heats from ambient +5 to 100°C and mixes orbitally at high speed, combining a heating block and shaker in one instrument.
Wide High-Speed Range: Microprocessor PID control ensures consistent, precise shaking across a wide 150 to 1500 rpm range (block-dependent), with a 2 mm orbit suited to tubes and plates.
Programmable Interval Mix: An interval-mix function continuously switches between shaking and phasing, and can be set precisely in program mode to match each experimental condition.
Program Memory: A memory function stores relevant parameters - temperature, rpm and time - for each program step, with up to 10 programs of up to 10 steps each.
Dual Wait-Timer Modes: Advanced dual wait on/off timer modes let the user start the timer immediately, or only after the set temperature is reached.
Optimal Heat Transfer: A tight coupling design between the main body and corrosion-resistant anodized aluminum blocks achieves optimal, uniform heat transfer.
Automatic Temperature Calibration: Automatic temperature calibration keeps readings accurate, displayed on a bright VFD with 0.1°C resolution and responsive touch buttons.

Low-Vibration Design and Safety: A low-profile design with rubber feet minimises vibration and noise, and safety features include over-temperature protection on the heating plate and PCB, current-limit protection, a self-diagnostic function and a chemical-resistant polypropylene body.

A high-velocity fan and air-tight silicone door seal give uniform temperature distribution and rapid recovery, while the refrigerated R models add cooling to ambient -20°C using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ISS Series Incubated Shakers (Multi-Stackable) are large-capacity, triple-stackable incubated shakers that let laboratories multiply throughput in the same floor footprint, with reliable temperature control and stable shaking of high-load samples.
features: Triple-Stackable Design: Up to three large-capacity units stack using exclusive stacking kits and stands, saving bench and floor space while multiplying throughput.
Three Operating Modes: Each unit runs in Temperature and Shaking, Temperature only, or Shaking only mode, so different protocols can share a stack.

Durable Direct-Drive Motor: A direct-drive motor with outstanding durability - backed by a 5-year motor warranty - delivers minimized-vibration shaking, and a patented shaking structure (KR 10-1678160) keeps high-load samples stable.
Precise Temperature Control: Microprocessor PID control with temperature auto-tuning and calibration holds temperature to ±0.1°C fluctuation at 37°C in flask, up to 80°C.
Optional Refrigeration: R models cool to ambient -20°C (minimum +4°C) using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant; a defrost function is recommended below 25°C.

Convenient Operation: A glide-up door makes sample changes easy, an intuitive colour touch display shows all operation and error information, and high-brightness low-power LED illumination makes it easy to observe inside.
Soft Start/Stop and Easy Cleaning: Soft start and stop shaking, a spill drain port for internal cleanliness, and a countdown timer to 999 hr 59 min support safe, tidy, timed operation.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent precision sensor and controller, plus a conventional backup mechanical limiter (B-OT), provide reliable protection even during electronic faults.

Smart Self-Diagnosis and Connectivity: Real-time self-diagnostics monitor rpm and temperature against setpoints and raise alarms, the unit restarts automatically after power recovery, a controller-lock prevents accidental changes, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring (via LC GreenBox) and 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper support remote oversight and GMP audits.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ISS-3075/4075 Series Incubated Shakers (Stackable) are specially designed to be double-stacked on the floor or placed on lab benches for space saving, while delivering precise temperature control and high-speed shaking.
features: Space-Efficient Double Stacking: The best space-efficient model, designed to double-stack using exclusive stacking kits or sit on the bench, saving valuable laboratory space.
Three Operating Modes: Each unit runs in Temperature and Shaking, Temperature only, or Shaking only mode, so different protocols can share a stack.

High-Speed, Precise Control: Up to 500 rpm (19.1 mm orbit) with microprocessor PID control, temperature auto-tuning and calibration holds temperature to ±0.1°C fluctuation at 37°C in flask, up to 80°C.
Internal Power Outlet: An internal power outlet adds convenience for in-chamber accessories.
Optional Refrigeration: R models cool to ambient -20°C (minimum +4°C) using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant; a defrost function is recommended below 25°C.

Convenient Operation: An intuitive colour touch display shows all operation and error information, high-brightness low-power LED illumination makes it easy to observe inside, and a spill drain port keeps the chamber clean and easy to maintain.
Low Vibration and Soft Start/Stop: A shaking structure with minimized vibration, plus soft start and stop, keeps operation smooth and spill-free, with a countdown timer to 999 hr 59 min.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent precision sensor and controller, plus a conventional backup mechanical limiter (B-OT), provide reliable protection even during electronic faults.

Smart Self-Diagnosis and Connectivity: Real-time self-diagnostics monitor rpm and temperature against setpoints and raise alarms, the unit restarts automatically after power recovery, a controller-lock prevents accidental changes, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring (via LC GreenBox) and 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper support remote oversight and GMP audits.

faqs.question: What makes the ISS-3075/4075 Series different?
faqs.answer: It is space-efficient - designed to double-stack two units on the floor or sit on the bench.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range?

faqs.question: What is the speed range?
faqs.answer: 20 to 500 rpm as a single unit (19.1 mm orbit); stacked units run at 20 to 250 rpm.

faqs.question: Why is the stacked speed lower?
faqs.answer: Stacking limits maximum speed to 250 rpm to keep the stacked units stable.

faqs.question: What are the three operating modes?
faqs.answer: Temperature and Shaking, Temperature only, or Shaking only, selectable per unit.

faqs.question: What is the difference between ISS-3075 and ISS-4075?
faqs.answer: The ISS-3075 has an 80 L chamber (350 x 350 mm platform); the ISS-4075 has a 150 L chamber (450 x 450 mm platform).

faqs.question: What do the R models add?
faqs.answer: Refrigeration to ambient -20°C using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant.

faqs.question: How is it protected against over-temperature?
faqs.answer: A dual system: an electronic advanced limiter (A-OT) with independent sensor and a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT).

faqs.question: Is it suitable for GMP environments?
faqs.answer: Yes. It integrates with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper (option) and has smart self-diagnosis.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help plan, stack and install it?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help plan placement, select stacking kits, casters, platforms and clamps, and support installation, qualification and training.
